sample_non_stop_action_single: sample a single non-stop action from a Habitat action space dictionary
sample_non_stop_action_batch: sample multiple non-stop actions from a Habitat action space and return a list
sample_non_stop_action_gym_single: sample a single non-zero action from a gym Discrete action space
sample_non_stop_action_gym_batch: sample multiple non-zero actions from a gym Discrete action space and return a list
